endorsement.description: A change: effective from the next policy period (R04).

oneOf.description: A recommendation of the AI layer, applied by the engine's rules.
The engine's rules alone, such as a trigger match.
The customer's own choice, such as an allocation they confirmed (R03).

sum_insured.description: Sum insured (indemnity) or benefit amount per trigger event (parametric) this premium buys.

alternatives.description: Covers with room for that premium, and what makes each useful.

beyond_capacity.description: The same shortfall measured on the plan's capacity; equals `unallocated`.

placed_beyond_need.description: Premium the default places beyond what the customer can use now.

unallocated.description:
Plan price no split can place: the remaining covers' limits are full, for example after a
postponement (R41). Above zero, the customer may change plan or cancel without penalty
before the period starts; no plan is suggested (R42, R45).

Alternative.description: Room for more premium in one cover of the plan.

can_take.description: The most extra premium the cover can take this period.

exposure.description: What makes the extra cover usable: declaring it (a trip, a ticket, a device).

decision_id.description: The decision reviewed, from the decision log.

original_reviewer.description: The person whose decision is reviewed: they may not review it themselves.

oneOf.description: The decision stands.

shadow.description: A candidate factor, rated in shadow only (R43).

withheld.description: Not disclosed or not consented: rated at the undeclared group average (R33).

oneOf.description: A person assesses it: no assessment could be made.

evidence_reused.description: The fingerprint check found evidence sent before (R14 anomaly indicator).

Assessment.description:
The AI assessor's reading of the evidence, already parsed into this type. `estimate` is the
loss the evidence shows; it is a check on the amount claimed, never the amount paid.

escalation.description: What the assessor saw that needs a person or makes the case urgent (R46).

AuditFinding.description: A person's finding on an audited decision: agreed, or overturned with a note (R14).

kind.description: The decision kind, such as `claim` or `payout`.

AuditReason.description: Why a person looks at an automated decision.

oneOf.description: Its anomaly score reached `risk_review_threshold`.
Drawn in the random sample, `audit_sample_rate` of decisions (R14).

AuditRecord.description: A decision drawn for audit after the fact, waiting for a person (R14).

AuditStats.description:
How often people overturn the automated path, per decision kind. Only the random sample
counts: risk-reviewed decisions were chosen for looking odd, so they would overstate it. The
rate estimates the automated path's error and shows drift between periods.

CancellationData.description: What cancellation does to data (R20, R54).

delete.description: Optional data the customer opted into; deleted now.

retain_records_until.description: Policy, premium, claims, ledger and offer records are kept, access-restricted, until then.

ChannelInfo.description: Whether a partner's channel can bind cover today (R52).

binds.description: True only with a licence valid today.

refer_to.description: Where to send the customer when the partner cannot bind: the insurer's own journey.

evidence.description: Registered evidence kinds sent so far.

urgent.description: Urgent by the rules or the AI's escalation (R46); never reset.

ClaimEvidence.description: Evidence for a claim: what each file is (registered kinds) and the files.

ClaimNotice.description: The customer's first notification of loss.

asked_for_person.description: The customer asked for a person (R46).

circumstance.description: One of `guardrails.human_care.urgent`, when the customer reports one (R46).

guarantee_requested.description: A guarantee of payment a hospital or provider asks for; zero when none (R46).

ClaimPayment.description:
A claim payment approved: cash first, then settlement in kind the cover's terms permit, that
is suitable now and worth at least the cash (R16, R28). Posted once under its key (R27).

ClaimRecord.description: A claim as the store keeps it and the customer sees it.

guarantee_reference.description: The guarantee above the automatic cap, sent to the assistance provider to confirm.

triage.description: The triage when notified, with any first response (R46).

ClaimReferral.description: Why a claim is with a person.

oneOf.description: No cover in force for the loss: outside the policy period, lapsed, not held or excluded.

oneOf.description:
Premium may be allocated. After a postponement, losses before `reentry_waiting_until`

Excluded: no premium can be allocated before `until`; then the risk class is reassessed.

ConsentsUpdate.description: The customer's opt-ins, by registered data type (R20).

CopyPack.description: One language's copy, as the apps fetch it.

text.description: Text by dotted key, such as `plans.title`; `{name}` marks a value the app fills in.

CoverInfo.description: One cover of the catalogue as a customer reads it.

daily_benefit.description:

exposure.description: What makes the cover protect the customer (R42).

partner_id.description: The partner whose channel they first came through (R52).

oneOf.description: Straight through, on the assessor's recommendation and the rules.

reviewer.description: The person who decided, when `actor` is a person.

subject_type.description: What was decided about, such as `claim` or `prevention_task`.

kind.description: A registered declared item kind (`config/exposure_types.yaml`), such as `device.phone`.

DeclineReason.description:

oneOf.description: Fraud, which only a person finds (R10, R13).

DemoSession.description: A synthetic principal and its token.

EarnedFor.description:
What a reward can be earned for. A closed type with no claim-free variant: no reward is ever

oneOf.description: A verified prevention activity (R10, R40).

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

rule.description: The business rule that refused the request (`docs/rules.md`), when one did.

human_care.description: Signs of distress or vulnerability: a person takes the case.

EvidenceFile.description: Evidence as uploaded: base64 of the file, with its media type.

ExperienceStudy.description: A study over a book, for the actuary.

as_of.description: The month the study runs to, `YYYY-MM`.

Exposure.description:
What a customer must have for a cover to protect them this policy period. The optimiser
places usable premium only where there is exposure (R42).

of.description: For declared items and upcoming events: registered kinds; a parent covers its subtree.

ExposureKind.description:
How a cover finds whom it protects. The engine computes the customer's need differently for
each form; the kinds of items and events are registered in `config/exposure_types.yaml` (R55,
ADR-005).

oneOf.description: Declared working hours (R08).
A declared regular route.
A declared item of a registered kind, with its value.
An upcoming event of a registered kind in the policy period, after the waiting period.
Anyone covered has the exposure.

Figure.description: One aggregate. `value` is withheld when the cohort is too small (R21).

cohort_size.description: Customers the figure is computed over.

FirstAction.description:
What the first response does (`guardrails.human_care.first_response`). A closed set: each is
carried out by the assistance channel.

oneOf.description: Local emergency numbers, shown at once.
A call or chat with the assistance provider, opened at once.
A guarantee of payment to the hospital or provider, automatic up to the cap.

FirstResponse.description: The automatic first response to an urgent case.

guarantee.description: None when no guarantee was asked for, or no cover in the class is active.

FraudFinding.description:
A person's finding that a rewarded activity was fraudulent. Only a person finds fraud (R10,
R13).

oneOf.description: Every one must pass, measured, to scale up.
Any one breached stops the pilot.

Grant.description:
A reward granted into the customer's reward balance: the amount earned, reduced to the room
left under the monthly cap (R17).

over_cap.description: Earned but over the monthly cap; the customer is told.

Guarantee.description:
A guarantee of payment: automatic up to `auto_guarantee_cap`, the rest only once the
assistance provider confirms.

GuaranteeRecord.description: A guarantee of payment sent to the assistance provider to confirm (R46).

InKindOrder.description: An instruction to a supplier to deliver one in-kind option, with the amount reserved for it.

option.description: The in-kind option or the partner reward's offer id.

order_id.description: The settled payout's or the redemption's idempotency key.

JobRow.description: A job as the ops console lists it.

oneOf.description: Out of attempts: a person looks.

JobsView.description:

waiting for a person.

MeasureRow.description: One prevention measure: claim frequency with and without a verified activity.

credibility_bps.description: On the claims of both groups together.

frequency_with_bps.description: Claims per policy period, in basis points.

Money.description: Money in minor units (cents). No floating point in money paths (R29).

explanation.description: One plain sentence from the AI layer (R23).

oneOf.description:
New business: a first schedule, bound through `partner_id` or, with none, the insurer's
own journey (R52, R58).

OpsSnapshot.description:
What the ops console shows: the queue in order, the fairness audit and the audit overturn
rates.

oneOf.description: A parametric payout the customer took in kind (R28).
A partner reward bought with the reward balance (R16).

invoiced payout, paid in cash.
Not delivered in time: the amount reserved goes back to the customer.

flagged.description: Credible groups below `min_parity_ratio` of the best.

min_ratio.description: The lowest credible rate over the highest; none with fewer than two credible groups.

PartnerResults.description:
A distribution partner's results: aggregates over the customers who came through it, and
over everyone who took one of its rewards.

PayoutDecision.description: One payout to one policy on one loss occurrence, at one stage (R27).

options.description:
Cash first, always (R16); then alternatives every cover in the payout permits, that are
suitable now and worth at least the cash they replace (R28).

PayoutNotice.description: A parametric payout as the customer sees it.

settled.description: None while the customer is choosing between cash and an alternative (R16, R28).

PayoutStage.description: R51: the guaranteed share is paid at once; the balance when the loss occurrence closes.

PersonAction.description: What a person can do with an item.

oneOf.description: Approve a claim at the loss the person assessed.
Decline a claim, with a reason (R13).
Credit a prevention task (R10).
Agree with an audited decision (R14).
Overturn an audited decision, or a decision under review (R14, R15).
Let a decision under review stand (R15).

PersonDecision.description:
A person's decision on a work item. The action must be one the item offers; the person is
the caller (ADR-010).

amount.description: For an approval: the loss the person assessed (R48).

decline_reason.description: For a decline: the reason, from the closed list (R13).

evidence_kinds.description: For a request for evidence: the registered kinds asked for.

PersonOutcome.description: A person's decision on a claim with them.

oneOf.description: Pay the loss the person assessed, up to the sum insured (R48).
Ask the customer for more evidence of these registered kinds.

PersonRoute.description: Whether and how a person comes in.

oneOf.description: The usual path; the customer can still ask for a person at any time.
After the first response a person is offered; the customer chooses.
A person takes the case: the customer asked, or needs human care.

One pilot gate, as fixed before the pilot started (`pilot.yaml`): a bound in the metric's own
terms, a rate as a fraction and hours as hours.

value.description: None when there is nothing to measure yet.

The pilot's report: what the book shows, with the gates to evaluate it against

A fixed plan, the same for every customer (R01). Chosen by the customer, never recommended
(R45).

What the customer pays for a plan on a day. The plan price itself, which is allocated across
covers, stays at `list_price`; the discount is paid by its funder.

commute_routes.description: Declared routes a route-matched trigger pays on (R55).

upcoming_events.description:
Declared tickets and bookings a ticket- or booking-matched trigger pays on, with their
declared value (R55).

work_areas.description: Declared work areas an area-matched trigger pays on (R55, ADR-012).

PolicyPeriod.description: One policy period. `ends` is the first day after it, so consecutive periods share a date.

PolicyRecord.description: The policy as the store keeps it.

premium_due.description: The premium for the current period is due on its first day (R53).

endorsements.description: Accepted changes for the next policy period (R04).

effect.description: The effect they earn in this pool, at most `max_effect` (R11).

period_index.description: The policy period it pays for: the current one.

oneOf.description: Cover continues; a claim is paid net of the premium due (R53).

due.description: Last day evidence can be sent: the event's start, or the policy period's last day.

action.description: What the customer does, in one sentence.

avg_claim_cost.description: Average claim cost in the class, at most the customer's sum insured (R48).

claim_prob_before.description: This customer's claim probability per policy period without and with the action (R40).

What the AI prevention task writer proposes for a known event: the action and its evidence

action.description: What the customer does, in one sentence (R23).

evidence.description: One of the measure's evidence kinds the customer has consented to (R20).

task_type.description:

`screen_protector_fitted`.

oneOf.description: A customer, on a partner's channel or the insurer's own journey (`partner_id` none).
A distribution partner's server (R21, R52).

A data source pushing its reports (R55).

Privileges.description: What a plan adds beyond the launch-phase catalogue, set in config only (R45).

What the engine may know about a customer. No protected attributes here (R19); industry

which never reaches the AI layer.

consents.description: Registered optional data types the customer opted into (`config/data_types.yaml`, R20).

language.description:
The customer's language setting, one of the insurer's `languages.offered`; none means
the market default.

work_areas.description:
Registered areas (a district, county or city) where the declared hours are worked, for a
trigger reported per area (R55, ADR-012). The insured location: never an AI input (R19).

ProfileFactsView.description: Facts read from the answers, in registered ids, for the customer to confirm in their profile.

language.description: One of the insurer's offered languages.

work_areas.description: Registered areas where the declared hours are worked (ADR-012).

language.description: The language tag the form is written in.

channel.description: The channel the customer came from, such as `delivery_app` or `direct`.

options.description: Answers to tap; empty for a typed answer.

insured. Finer than `Bps` because micro-cover rates are small (ADR-004).

A registered rating factor the customer may answer, with the answers its table rates (R33).

oneOf.description: Delivered by the supplier, which is paid the price on delivery (R56).

oneOf.description: The verifier gave no verdict (R22).

utc_offset_minutes.description: Minutes east of UTC of market local time.

placed_beyond_need.description: Premium the default places beyond what the customer can use now.
